title: crassocephalum bauchiense
intro: Crassocephalum bauchiense, commonly known as Bauchi crassocephalum, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in West Africa, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crassocephalum bauchiense include wound healing, antimalarial, and antiparasitic effects, making it a valuable resource in rural communities. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
